display.purpose: Display and page headings; bundled locally under SIL OFL 1.1.

body.purpose: Body text, labels, and metadata; bundled locally under SIL OFL 1.1.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Short control state transitions, disabled when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action with explicit focus, active, disabled, and loading states.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--q-action); color: var(--q-action-text); font: 700 15px/1.25 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--q-action-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--q-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; transform: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action on the young-shoot surface.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--q-surface-secondary); color: var(--q-text); font: 700 15px/1.25 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--q-surface-accent); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--q-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action with a persistent hover surface.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--q-text); font: 700 15px/1.25 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background: var(--q-surface-secondary); } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--q-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-ghost:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-ghost { transition: none; } }

components.name: Input
components.description: Labeled text entry with a visible focus ring and accessible error text.
components.html: Erreur : Adresse invalide.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--q-text); font: 600 14px/1.25 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--q-border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--q-surface); color: var(--q-text); font: 400 16px/1.5 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--q-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--q-error-border); } .ds-error { color: var(--q-text); font: 600 14px/1.5 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Surface
components.description: Flat semantic container with an approved tonal surface.
components.css: .ds-surface { padding: 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--q-canvas); color: var(--q-text); font: 400 16px/1.5 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Error Badge
components.description: Text-labeled error state; color never carries its meaning alone.
components.css: .ds-badge-error { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--q-error-border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--q-error); color: var(--q-text); font: 600 14px/1.25 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 44px square icon action with a required accessible name.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Fermer"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: inline-grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--q-text); transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: var(--q-surface-secondary); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--q-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-icon-button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-icon-button { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview: This direction is derived from the supplied product brief: a contemporary, vegetal, sunlit kitchen expressed with the hierarchy and precision of modern software. The visual language pairs deep forest typography with leafy surfaces, peach warmth, and small, deliberate terracotta and tomato accents. It should feel vivid and composed rather than rustic or template-driven. The system keeps familiar web controls and a clear information hierarchy. Color, typography, and compact botanical references carry the identity; they do not change how navigation or controls work. There is no licensed Sharp Grotesk 20 or Graphik asset in the repository, so local SIL Open Font License alternatives are used until properly licensed files are supplied.
keyCharacteristics: Vegetal color with warm, sunlit surface contrast.
Editorial headings paired with readable, measured body text.
Standard accessible controls with restrained state motion.

rules.name: The Palette-Only Rule
rules.body: Use only the eight brand colors in interface elements. Semantic roles may reuse them; do not add neutral ramps or default Tailwind colors.

rules.name: The Contrast Pairing Rule
rules.body: Body text uses forest on pale brand surfaces. Leaf text is reserved for pairings that meet normal-text contrast. Terracotta is not normal text. Error meaning includes a word or icon shape as well as color.

rules.name: The Quiet-Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer tonal surfaces and clear spacing over stacked containers or decorative shadows.

dos: Do source all interface colors from apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css.
Do keep French user-facing copy and English code identifiers and comments.
Do preserve labels, keyboard operation, visible focus, and reduced-motion preferences.
Do use local licensed font files and retain their license notices.
Do verify food metrics before presenting them as real.
donts: Don't use white, gray, brown, beige, black, or un-tokenized Tailwind colors in interface elements.
Don't use terracotta for normal-sized text or place forest text on forest surfaces.
Don't communicate error or availability by color alone.
Don't generate recipe cards, application pages, or route demos as part of this foundation phase.
